subject: Mathematics

internalBreakdown.component: Pen Paper Test and Multiple Assessment (5+5)
Lab Practical (activities from the prescribed books)

textbooks: Guidelines for Mathematics Laboratory in Schools, class X (CBSE)
Mathematics exemplar problems for class X (NCERT)

chapters.name: Real Numbers
topics: Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic: statements after reviewing earlier work and motivating through examples
Proofs of irrationality of √2, √3, √5
outcomes: Describes the Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic with examples
Proves algebraically the irrationality of numbers like √2, √3, √5, 3 + 2√5

chapters.name: Polynomials
topics: Zeros of a polynomial
Relationship between zeros and coefficients of quadratic polynomials
outcomes: Finds the zeros of a polynomial graphically and algebraically, and verifies the relation between zeros and coefficients of quadratic polynomials

chapters.name: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables
topics: Pair of linear equations in two variables and graphical method of their solution; consistency/inconsistency
Algebraic conditions for number of solutions
Algebraic solution by substitution and by elimination; simple situational problems
outcomes: Finds the solution of a pair of linear equations in two variables graphically and algebraically (substitution and elimination)

chapters.name: Quadratic Equations
topics: Standard form of a quadratic equation ax² + bx + c = 0 (a ≠ 0)
Solutions (only real roots) by factorisation and by the quadratic formula
Relationship between discriminant and nature of roots
Situational problems based on day-to-day activities
outcomes: Solves quadratic equations using factorisation and the quadratic formula
Determines the nature of roots using the discriminant
Formulates and solves problems based on real-life contexts

chapters.name: Arithmetic Progressions
topics: Motivation for studying Arithmetic Progression
Derivation of the nth term and sum of the first n terms of an AP; application to daily-life problems
outcomes: Applies AP concepts to find the nth term and the sum of n terms
Applies AP to real-life problems

chapters.name: Coordinate Geometry
topics: Review of coordinate geometry concepts
Distance formula
Section formula (internal division)
outcomes: Solves problems using the distance formula and section formula

chapters.name: Triangles
topics: Definitions, examples and counter-examples of similar triangles
(Prove) A line parallel to one side of a triangle divides the other two sides in the same ratio
(State) A line dividing two sides of a triangle in the same ratio is parallel to the third side
(State) AAA similarity: equal corresponding angles imply proportional sides
(State) SSS similarity: proportional corresponding sides imply equal angles
(State) SAS similarity: one equal angle with proportional including sides
outcomes: Proves the Basic Proportionality Theorem and applies it and its converse
Proves similarity of triangles using the similarity criteria

chapters.name: Circles
topics: Tangent to a circle at the point of contact
(Prove) The tangent at any point of a circle is perpendicular to the radius through the point of contact
(Prove) Lengths of tangents drawn from an external point to a circle are equal
outcomes: Proves the theorems on tangents to a circle
Applies tangent properties to solve problems

chapters.name: Introduction to Trigonometry
topics: Trigonometric ratios of an acute angle of a right-angled triangle; proof that they are well defined
Ratios defined at 0° and 90°; values at 30°, 45° and 60°
Relationships between the ratios
outcomes: Evaluates trigonometric ratios
Uses ratios of standard angles to solve related expressions

chapters.name: Trigonometric Identities
topics: Proof and applications of sin²A + cos²A = 1
Only simple identities
outcomes: Proves trigonometric identities using sin²A + cos²A = 1 and other identities

chapters.name: Heights and Distances
topics: Angle of elevation and angle of depression
Simple problems on heights and distances
outcomes: Finds heights and distances in real-life word problems using trigonometric ratios
notes: Problems should not involve more than two right triangles

chapters.name: Areas Related to Circles
topics: Area of sectors and segments of a circle
Problems on areas and perimeter/circumference of these figures
outcomes: Visualises and evaluates areas of sectors and segments of a circle
notes: Area of a segment restricted to central angles of 60°, 90° and 120°

chapters.name: Surface Areas and Volumes
topics: Surface areas and volumes of combinations of any two of: cubes, cuboids, spheres, hemispheres, right circular cylinders/cones
outcomes: Evaluates surface areas and volumes of combinations of solids by visualisation

chapters.name: Statistics
topics: Mean, median and mode of grouped data
outcomes: Computes the mean of a grouped frequency distribution by direct, assumed-mean and step-deviation methods
Computes the median and mode of a grouped frequency distribution algebraically

chapters.name: Probability
topics: Classical definition of probability
Simple problems on finding the probability of an event
outcomes: Determines probabilities in simple real-life problems
